### INOVIO to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/283306112/files/doc_news/INOVIO-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-e7f2cec15-2026.pdf)


PLYMOUTH MEETING, Pa.


, Nov. 11, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- INOVIO (NASDAQ: INO), a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on developing DNA medicines to help treat and protect people from HPV-related diseases, cancer and infectious diseases, today announced that it will participate in the following investor conferences:


**Jefferies G** **lobal** **Healthcare Conference** in London
**Date:** Wednesday, November 18
**Time:** 12:00 p.m. EST / 5:00 p.m **.** GMT
**Format:** Presentation
**Webcast:**[https://event.summitcast.com/view/avibSrFufLKeoLRAEgMxy6/e3gFZPzHNgoxtsxeAwXEr2](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819533-1&h=806779811&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FavibSrFufLKeoLRAEgMxy6%2Fe3gFZPzHNgoxtsxeAwXEr2&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FavibSrFufLKeoLRAEgMxy6%2Fe3gFZPzHNgoxtsxeAwXEr2)


**Piper Sandler 38** **th** **Annual Healthcare Conference** in New York
**Date:** Tuesday, December 1
**Time:** 2:00-2:25 p.m. EST
**Format:** Fireside chat
**Webcast:**[https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1782025&tp_key=9cacd40318](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819533-1&h=1282816181&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1782025%26tp_key%3D9cacd40318&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1782025%26tp_key%3D9cacd40318)


Replays of the presentations will be available for 90 days at the links above. During these conferences members of INOVIO's management team will also be conducting one-on-one meetings with investors.


**About INOVIO** INOVIO is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on developing DNA medicines to help treat and protect people from HPV-related diseases, cancer, and infectious diseases. INOVIO's technology optimizes the design and delivery of innovative DNA medicines that enable the body to manufacture its own disease-fighting tools. For more information, visit[www.inovio.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819533-1&h=897319051&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4811365-1%26h%3D2725776183%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.inovio.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.inovio.com&a=www.inovio.com) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819533-1&h=1095974375&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4811365-1%26h%3D2982908224%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.linkedin.com%252Fcompany%252Finovio-pharmaceuticals%252F%26a%3DLinkedIn&a=LinkedIn) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819533-1&h=1738723888&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4811365-1%26h%3D99960965%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fx.com%252Finoviopharma%26a%3DX&a=X) (formerly known as Twitter).
